resources.string: While this is on, Arcify can\'t be uninstalled until you switch it off here. Arcify never locks, wipes or manages your phone.
Turning this off removes Arcify\'s uninstall protection.
Arcify: you\'ve reached today\'s limit of %1$d %2$s
Arcify: only the reel sent in this chat is allowed
Arcify: %s isn\'t on your study list
Arcify: study mode only opens your allowed sites

Arcify uses this to see which app is open and, in apps you choose to control (like Instagram, YouTube and your browser), what is on screen. That lets it enforce your app limits, strict focus, Shorts and Reels rules, study modes and blocked websites. Everything is processed on your phone. Nothing is sent anywhere.
